title: Birth in 1904 and first piano pieces at age seven
summary: She gives her birth date and recalls learning Casey Jones and Steamboat Bill on piano at seven.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you mind telling when you were born? Some ladies don't like to tell their age.
It's not necessary if you don't like to.
Going back to Dixieland Music, I have to tell the truth. I was born January 11th, 1904. Oh, yeah.
Can you tell us when you first started in music and the very first music you remember hearing?
Well, I first started playing at 7 years old. And my first numbers on the piano were Casey Jones and Steamboat Bill.
I know the Casey Jones. I don't know the Steamboat Bill. I don't think so.

Well, that was my very first numbers. I had listened at it for a long time and was just wishing for the time I'd get a piano. And I had it in my mind so much that when I got a piano, I just went right and played it. I pictured the notes in my mind so that I could go right and play it. You just played it at the key. That's right.
